Summing in v counts each edge twice and yields I_n(p); summing in u yields the displayed incoming mass. For fixed n only u within B(o,n) contribute.

reproduction: Each site's state reads labels in B_infty(x,R+1), so dependence range is at most 2R+2 in sup norm. Adjacent open sites have the same minimizer label, confining each component to one radius-R box. The one-site event is that the minimum over the union of 2d+1 shifted boxes lies in their intersection; counting gives a_R=(2R-1)^d/((2R+1)^d+2d(2R+1)^(d-1)), tending to one.
remaining_gap: This field is not iid Bernoulli; it refutes only high marginals with an uncontrolled growing dependence range.
